en:
You don't mind if I borrow your ear for a moment?"

Logus takes a stool beside you and gazes into the firelight, a tired expression stretched across his face.

"This may come as a surprise to you, but I was a naval captain before I was a Lukattite. For more than fifteen years, I sailed the waters between Crest and Tsarath, sometimes as a freighter, sometimes as a patrol. 

Nothing like it, being out on the water.
|Maybe I just got too cocky. Started thinking of the ship as mine, the crew as mine, the ocean as mine. 

I did my job, of course, but that became an afterthought.

I was often tasked with taking down pirates, but I often found ways to deal with them that didn't involve stringing them up. 

I was never specifically told to string them up, of course. Not at first, anyway, but when word got back to the nobility in Crest, they weren't too happy. 

I was reprimanded, given a stern warning and all, but you can imagine what I thought of that, I'm sure. 

|I kept doing things my way. I foolishly thought that there was nothing they could do about it. 

Eventually, they'd had enough, and put a sniffer in my crew.

We had on different hands all the time, so I thought nothing of it, really, but when we get back into port, they're waiting with guards, and this swabber turns around and puts me under arrest for defying the crown. What was I gonna say? I did defy the crown, didn't I?

|Well that was probably bad enough, but I fought them. My crew came to my side, or most of 'em did. 

It didn't matter. 

They beat us down, put me on trial, and executed nine of my sailors. They made me watch.

As for me, I'll give you three guesses as to what old Captain Logus' fate was. They wanted to make sure that all the other captains in their employ got the message loud and clear, and fell into line like trained hounds. 

|Well, I've been trying to find a way off this island ever since. I found that boat, but before you came along, I never managed to put together crew enough to actually sail it. 

Fat lot of good that did us. 

At least now we know our enemy, such as it is. I got no idea how we're gonna overcome a Sud'umKatch, but when you don't have any ideas, that's when you get creative, ain't it?

|Anyway, thanks. For everything. For getting me out of the shipyard, for lighting that beacon, for patching me up and bringing me along. 

You've done enough to prove to me that you're the stuff a real captain is made of, and for that, I salute you.

This fucking island. There is something really weird happening here. It would be a lot easier to toss my hat into the sea and spend the rest of me days getting drunk at the shipyard. Ah well. This is more fun, probably. Nobody at the shipyard took me seriously anyway.
You don't want me along anymore? If you're worried about my health, you shouldn't be.
Good to see you, mate. Come to chat?
I might be past my prime, but an old orc is still a good thing to have on your side. Trust me.
Well, drinking by the sea it is, then. I wish you luck.
As long as you're alright with me waiting at the entrance, I'm with you wherever you go.
Hi. We going out soon?
Sure. Just give the word.
I've picked up how to make a lot of useful things. Take a look, see if I have anything you might need.
Looking to buy?
It takes me a while to make new things, so you may not see me again for a while.

I've a wide range of studies and knowledges, not the least of which is commerce. I shall advise the goings-on of merchants and the like. You'll find prices improved all around, and you'll have an easier time selling some of the more esoteric things you come across. Sounds useful, no?
A good day to you, darling. What assistance can I provide?
Everybody gets a better deal this way, darling. Believe me.
Flee now, or your lives are forfeit!
Scatter them.
Perhaps this will prove of some use.
Is this significant?
You are becoming tiresome.
It is time for you to die.
I doubt there is anything of significance here.
I am here.
A true test of my power!
I cannot die, fool. Come.

Stand aside, 
and witness my power!
Surely you are not so pathetic.
Fear is for the weak!
Out of my way, coward.
All part of my design.
Most impressive.

Are you raising an army? Interesting. The machinations of mortals, while inevitably doomed to failure, are nonetheless entertaining to behold. I shall stay a while longer, to see what fruit your labour bears.
If you no longer have need of me, I shall go. I have schemes of my own to attend.
What is it you desire?
A wise choice. I am an asset that could not be easily replaced.
Farewell then, mortal. We shall not meet again.
You are impressive. What would you have of me?
You overstep your bounds, fool!
Yes, a fair bargain, I should think. Take your trophy.
You will have to do better than that if you expect me to serve the likes of you!
Very well. You have earned my service.
The day, then, is yours.
I shall aid you then, for as long as it pleases me to do so. Direct me.
A brave one, are you? Not many would dare to approach one such as I, let alone share their words, but fear not. If my business involved you, you would well know it.
Begone, lest you rouse my temper.
An alliance with you? How amusing. Still, there is always a use for overeager fools. Perhaps it will serve my interests.
A coward after all? Predictable. Extricate yourself.

You are a most unusual being. When I agreed to serve you, I expected little more than a trite amusement, but now I find myself embroiled in your struggles. It is not often that I learn something unexpected of mortals and the workings of their minds, but this occasion has been most... informative. 

I have decided to offer a pact of servitude. Your goals shall be my goals. 

Let us see them done.
It has been long since I have walked alongside a mortal Lord. To see our enemies tremble in terror at my power, and to see their eyes acknowledge your command of such majesty, it is delectable.
If I leave, I shall not return while you draw breath. Are you quite certain?
Yes, my Lord?
It is only natural you would fear the power of a being such as I. Such is the plight of man.
Then, I shall watch this unfold from afar. I know you will not disappoint me.

Oh don't you worry, nobody gives me any lip. Any that do get a real rude awakening. I keep a close eye on the supplies, make sure nobody gets greedy. I can watch over stuff you wanna keep for later, and I can see to selling off the stuff you don't. Just leave it to me.
What is it dear?
Take care of yourself.
Oh don't worry about a thing. I'll have the injured back on their feet in no time with my cutting-edge medical procedures.
Would you like some leeches?
Yes, just leave it to me.
Fear not. None shall perish under my care. I hear the thrumming of the pulse of the world, the drum that beats the rhythm of life. I shall guide the injured to wellness again.
Yes, child? Can I help with something?
Go with the wind at your back.
The creature's attention is fixated on you.
Would you like to permanently release the creature?
The creature has noticed you.
The creature leaves.
The creature hesitates in its assault.
The creature does not understand, and resumes its assault.
The creature drops something and flees the battle.
The creature submits, and accepts your control over it.
The creature flees the battle.
The creature responds to your commands.
It doesn't even seem to notice you. Its gaze is fixated on the water.
The creature seems mesmerized by the glowing pond.
The creature does not resist.
The creature resumes what it was doing.
After spending so much time together, the creature seems much more comfortable under your command than it was when you started. Your bond, however unlikely, has grown stronger.
The creature seems to be paying attention to you.
The creature follows your every move.
Can't really set up anything large scale here on this island, or you'll get raided. There's ways, though, ways to do things in secret and still raise more than enough food.
Farming is all I've ever known. Ain't gonna stop now.
I'll come back sometime when I got more crop.

It's refreshing to be able to use my hammer again. I've been making bits and bobs for the hold, of course, but I'd really love to get my hands on some weapons. Bring me two identical pieces if you want to see me work my magic.
Need something sharpened?
Of course. Remember to come find me when you need an upgrade.

So many voices... 
I will silence you!
... a purpose?
... here...
... one fewer...
... I warned you...
... just stop... please...
Ahahaha... hahaha!!
Drown in darkness!

... yes. 
Come and embrace death.
Stop the voices!
You will know my pain!
... useless.
Make an offering of your pain.
... now you understand.
... you fool...
You cannot see the meaninglessness of this. You fight and claw against the very wind, but in the end you will fall, and they will all fall with you. It is only a matter of time.
You mean to banish me?
What do you hope to gain by this toil?
Do not rouse my ire further, fool.
Will I never be free of this curse?
You will not survive!
Never! It is mine!
Yes, take it, greedy flesh, and I will be free at last!
Warm blood, thundering heart, be silent!
I... cannot refuse.
Mercy? How can that be?
I have long ached for the warmth of mortal company. Very well.
I have warned you. This place runs thick with curse, and I am no more. Even in death, I cannot know peace, and before long I may forget everything, even myself.
This place is cursed. Begone from here.
You... would risk keeping one so cursed under your mantle? Are you truly so foolish?
I thought not. Begone, before you are cursed as well.

I don't know what you have done, but I can feel the coils that keep me here beginning to loosen. 

At first, I thought you an ordinary fool flirting with darkness, but something about your struggle is wiping the curse clean from this place. If following you will allow me to end this wretched eternity, then you will have my loyalty to the last unholy breath. 

Do not disappoint me.
It is quieter now. The screams have faded, and I sometimes catch spaces of silence, glimpses of peace through cursed clouds. When all of this is finished, I shall sleep soundly indeed.
Is it time for me to go?
I am listening.
Of course. There is more to be done.
I have never known such fatigue. Release the bindings that anchor me, and go with my thanks.
Kill all things!
Fight! Fight!
Shiny!
What this?
I kill!!
You die!
I smell a thing.
Listen. You hear?
Run away!
More kill!
Kill many things!
Stupid!
You shut stupid mouth!
Haha, stupid and dead!
You full of big stupids! Give food now!
You no need?
You need, yes.
Gah! You too strong!
You no take! NO TAKE!!
You take! I go!
I kill you dead!
You strong, I follow!
Hate you! HATE YOU!!
I fight, you give food!
What you want?
Go away!
You give food? I help.
You stupid!
You strong! You give many food. I find. I give.
Many big and strong!
Not enough strong?
You strong!
I strong! You need.
I hate you! HATE YOU!!
Who's first?
That one in the front is mine.
I suppose I have to do it?
Look, over there.
Shit!
Over this way, asshole!
I smell... nah, it's nothing.
I can smell that, you know.
Fucking suicide run.

You want me dead?
Work for it, asshole!

Knock it off, you
sound like a pussy.

Not quite. 
There will be blood though.

I am gonna kick
your ass later.
Ugh, what a loser.
Oh, boo hoo.
Fuck you very much.

Okay, that wasn't an invitation to talk my ear off. You want me to come kick some heads, I'll do that, but if you think I'm gonna sit around the campfire with you and sing songs and talk about my feelings, you got another thing coming.
You want me to go back to Hayill?
Hi.
Well make up your damn mind.
Fine. You're kind of an asshole anyway.
Shit, what the hell is wrong with you?!
I don't fucking have anything!
You want the only thing I have? Fine. Die in a fire.
After this? Go to hell!
Okay, I get it, you're stronger than me. You're the boss.
Kick my ass and then kick me out of my own home? Fuck you.

Just because he's never actually been attacked, he thinks he doesn't need a bodyguard? He doesn't realize how many times I scared off threats with my eyes or by just showing my fangs. Now he wants me to go with you to fight motherfucking Frico? He knows it's a suicide job, he said it himself.
He thinks I'm fat and useless, does he?
Whatever, let's go already.
Got some stuff to take care of first? Fine. Just come find me when you're ready.

You got a second?

Sorry for snapping at you before. Compared to the sendoff I got back home, you treat me well, and I ought to try harder to recognize that. "

Grant stirs the embers of the fire a moment, and speaks without looking up.

"He's my father, you know. The asshole Alpha who sent me along with you. Lots of the guys back home had their brands heal away because of the lycanthropy, but I never had one. I was born here. 

|I was never allowed to talk about it, even though everybody knew. We didn't want to give anybody the impression that I had a cushy job just because I was the Alpha's pup. 

I took my job seriously, but... maybe it really was a cushy one. I mean look at me. 

I don't know if I'll ever go back to Hayill for good. Since being out here with you, I've seen so much, done so much, I don't think I could be content to just stay in one place anymore. Maybe my dad would be proud of that choice, maybe he'd feel betrayed. I don't really know, and I don't really know if I care. 

If I go back, and he wants to be my dad, I think that would be fine, but he's not my Alpha anymore."

|Grant stands up, turning his face into the firelight.

"Listen to me talking about my feelings by the fire, just like I said I wouldn't. 

I guess the whole point of all this was to let you know that I value this experience. I'll stay with you for as long as you think I'll be helpful. 

Now go on and let me take care of the fire, yeah?

This is pretty interesting, you know. Back in Hayill I spent every night of my entire life looking at the same ceiling. I never moved around so much, slept in so many different places. I think I might even be losing weight. I don't know how comfortable I am with that.
I have to go back and face my dad sooner or later. Are you sure you don't need me anymore?
Sure, I got a minute. What did you need?
I'll stick with you for as long as you want, but once I'm gone, I'm gone.
Well then good luck, and thanks for all the grub.
Stay sharp!
Don't let your guard down!
I wonder what purpose this serves.
Shall we see what that is?

Shit!
We don't need to be losing good people!
All clear.
How's it looking from your end?
Damn! This isn't looking good.
I'm thinking this is not going to end well.
It's nothing we can't handle if we work together!
Give us a little more credit than that!

Convince yourself it's over if you like.
I'm going to live!

Why don't you run, then?
I've got more fight in me yet!
Watch yourselves!

Pull it together!
We can still win!

An island you can't escape. Really, it is a perfect prison, so it's no wonder they use it as such, but the guards are as much prisoners as the criminals. I'm not even sure there's a difference. And what about the people who aren't criminals at all, who got sent here because of a mistake, or worse? This needs to stop.
Have I upset you somehow?
How are you today? Doing alright?
This place is dangerous, so try not to be hasty. I'm sure we can figure out something that works.
I see. Well, I will try to find an escape on my own then. Farewell.
Curse this wretched place!
No, I've had enough! You won't leave me robbed and helpless!
If that's what it takes to buy my life.
I will never work for a criminal!
I see. Fine, I will cooperate with you.
I am surprised. Thank you.
Let's be off then. Any direction is as good as another.

I have yet to discover any way to leave this place. I am beginning to think it is impossible. Is that why it was never conquered? Why prisoners are sent here? An island from which there is no escape...
I'm sorry, I don't know much about the surrounding area. I was just passing through when the crones grabbed me.
You want me to travel with you? Well, I do owe you one. I'll come along for a while at least.
I don't really know if that would be the best fit anyhow. Good luck regardless.
